page: Alibaba Cloud ecs.i4g.4xlarge is an x86_64 architecture server instance powered by an Intel Xeon 8369B processor running at a clock speed of 2.7 GHz. This instance is provisioned with 16 dedicated vCPUs and 64.0 GB of system memory, yielding a resource density of 4.0 GB of RAM per core. It operates on the KVM hypervisor.

A key feature of this instance is the inclusion of 959 GB of local SSD storage. This bundled local storage provides low-latency data access directly on the host. For network connectivity, the instance delivers a baseline network bandwidth of 10 Gbps. It does not include any integrated GPUs or complimentary public IPv4 addresses.

From a cost-efficiency perspective, the ecs.i4g.4xlarge offers a balanced resource profile by combining dedicated compute cores, a standard 1:4 vCPU-to-RAM ratio, and a substantial amount of local SSD storage. This configuration is designed for workloads requiring fast local storage and reliable compute performance without the overhead of external storage attachments. Suitable workloads include relational and non-relational databases, caching layers, and general-purpose enterprise applications that benefit from local SSD performance.
